newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinian inmates riot in Israeli prison.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian inmates riot in Israeli prison.

text.p: Palestinian inmates rioted at an Israeli army prison on Wednesday, the army said.
An army spokesman could not confirm an Israel Radio report that six inmates were injured in the unrest over the extension of detention of Palestinians without trial.
"Inmates of Megiddo prison rioted after it was decided to extend the administrative detention of a number of detainees," the spokesman said.
"Prisoners have burned a number of tents. Military police in cooperation with Israeli police are restoring order," the spokesman said.
A prisons spokeswoman said there was unrest at a second prison in southern Israel.
She denied the disturbances were related to tensions over Israeli construction of a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem.
"Security prisoners are banging on cell doors at Nakhsa prison but the situation is under control," she said. She added the two incidents were apparently unrelated.
